source: Local Codex session event_msg / token_count / info.total_token_usage counters; main agent only.
calculation: For each production, subtract the last cumulative counter before its production prompt from the final counter after delivery and before the next user request. Counters were monotonic within both intervals.

accounting.cached_input_tokens: Subset of input_tokens; do not add again.
accounting.reasoning_output_tokens: Subset of output_tokens; do not add again.

limitations: Historical production usage, including iterative authoring and repeated context processing; not a per-render or per-minute benchmark.
Separate subagent usage and ImageGen model usage are not included in these main-agent counters.
Local Chromium and FFmpeg rendering does not consume language-model tokens.
Token counts are not a USD cost estimate. Raw conversation logs are not distributed.
